maplessv.status_detail: No build recipe: the archive holds glucose-based sources with precompiled objects and a prebuilt glucose_static, a mini-init-lib and an m4ri tarball, without a top-level build script; the old generic builder finds nothing to build. Needs a Makefile-based recipe that rebuilds the solver and links mini-init-lib and m4ri instead of the shipped binary.
